name: Veena Karmachandani

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Veena Karmachandani, also published as Veena Karamchandani, is a Jaipur-based writer working in Sindhi and Hindi. Her place in contemporary Sindhi writing is reflected in Sahitya Akademi's account of women writers and in a Kachchh University poetry syllabus, which includes her Maau ji Saugaat. Her contributor note also identifies fiction and storytelling among her forms.

The Hindi sequence presented under Prahar uses short, sharply turned sections to question comfort, power and the expectations placed on women. Violence first appears as the quiet cultivation of endless desire; another section challenges the complacency of pity offered from privilege. The sequence then moves through womanhood and domestic freedom to an intimate act of self-preservation through self-love.
